checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
must.why: A single white leather-looking low-top sneaker.

must.item: The background is plain white, with no scenery or props.
must.why: Near-white background with only a soft shadow.

must.item: The entire shoe is visible with space around it.
must.why: Whole shoe in frame, though the sole edges sit fairly close to left and right edges (~50px margin).

must.item: No promotional text, badges or graphic borders appear.

faults.what: Shoe sits slightly low and wide in the frame, with tighter margins left and right than top.
Faint grey vignette or shadow at the edges, so the background is not pure white.

summary: A clean, square product photo of one white leather sneaker on a near-white background, with only minor framing and shadow quirks.
